description: This file defines the ServeCommand struct which implements command-line functionality for running the Swabble speech processing application. It handles configuration loading, initializes speech pipelines, manages wake word detection, and executes hooks based on speech input.

classes.name: ServeCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for running the Swabble speech application in foreground mode, handling configuration, speech streaming, wake detection, and hook execution.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously runs the speech stream, manages wake word detection, logs output, and executes hook jobs based on speech segments.

methods.name: matchesWake
methods.description: Checks if the input text matches the configured wake word or its aliases.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes the wake word or its aliases from the input text.
